articles.title: Inter-Class Football Tournament
articles.excerpt: Intense sports competition between 5th and 6th grade classes
articles.content:
Event Presentation:
The inter-class football tournament is an annual sports event that will bring together all 5th and 6th grade classes. This competition aims to promote team spirit, fair play, and sports values among our students.

Educational Objectives:

• Develop sports and technical skills
• Promote cooperation and mutual aid between students
• Learn to respect rules and opponents
• Manage emotions in a competitive context

Planned Schedule:

The tournament will take place over three consecutive days. Each class will form a team that will represent its colors. A pool system will allow all teams to play several matches before the final phases.
articles.author: Prof. Sport
procedure: Team registration by class and competition group formation
Elimination matches on the first day with pool system
Semi-finals on the second day between the best teams
Final and award ceremony on the third day
articles.schedule: Day 1: Registrations and elimination matches • Day 2: Semi-finals • Day 3: Final and award ceremony

articles.title: Science Museum Visit
articles.excerpt: Interactive science discovery for 2nd and 3rd graders
articles.content:
Trip Presentation:
This educational visit to the Science Museum will allow our 2nd and 3rd grade students to concretely discover the scientific principles studied in class, with a particular focus on renewable energies.

Educational Objectives:

• Understand different renewable energy sources
• Experiment with scientific principles in a fun way
• Develop scientific curiosity
• Make the connection between theory and practice

Planned Schedule:

Morning departure by bus, guided museum tour with practical workshops on renewable energies, lunch break on site, and return in the late afternoon.
articles.author: Mrs. Dubois
procedure: Guided tour of renewable energy exhibition
Lunch break from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM
articles.schedule: Morning: Transportation and guided tour • Mid-day: Wind turbine construction workshop • Afternoon: Interactive experiments and return

articles.title: Spelling Competition 2023
articles.content:
Competition Presentation:
The annual spelling competition aims to value excellence in French and encourage our students to master the subtleties of the French language. This year, the theme will be 'Digital Words'.

Educational Objectives:

• Improve spelling and grammar mastery
• Enrich students' vocabulary
• Develop self-confidence in writing
• Promote academic excellence

Planned Schedule:

The competition will begin with a written test followed by a dictation. The teachers' jury will then correct the papers and announce the results with an award ceremony.
articles.author: Mr. Martin
articles.schedule: Morning: Written test and dictation • Correction by jury • Afternoon: Results announcement and awards

articles.title: Creative Pottery Workshop
articles.content:
Workshop Presentation:
This pottery workshop will allow young children to develop their creativity while working on fine motor skills. Each child will leave with their personal creation.

Educational Objectives:

• Develop creativity and artistic expression
• Improve fine motor skills and coordination
• Learn to follow instructions step by step
• Gain confidence in creative abilities

Planned Schedule:

Welcome and material distribution, basic techniques demonstration, individual creation with support, drying time for artworks, collective material cleaning, and storage of creations for firing.
articles.author: Mrs. Laurent
articles.schedule: Session 1: Demonstration and creation • Session 2: Drying and cleaning • Final: Storage for firing

articles.title: Robotics Club
articles.excerpt: Introduction to programming and educational robotics
articles.content:
Club Presentation:
The robotics club offers a fun introduction to programming and engineering concepts. Students will build and program their first robots.

Educational Objectives:

• Introduce programming basics
• Develop logic and problem-solving
• Understand basic mechanical principles
• Work in teams on technical projects

Planned Schedule:

Weekly challenge presentation, team formation, robot construction and assembly, feature programming, testing and adjustments, and final presentations of achievements.
articles.author: Mr. Tech
articles.schedule: Weekly: New challenge • Team work • Programming • Testing • Presentation

articles.title: Christmas Show
articles.excerpt: Preparation of the annual end-of-year show
articles.content:
Show Presentation:
All classes are actively preparing the Christmas show that will bring families together for a magical moment of sharing and festivities.

Educational Objectives:

• Develop stage expression and self-confidence
• Learn to work in groups on a common project
• Discover performing arts
• Share a festive moment with families

Planned Schedule:

Role distribution by class, individual rehearsals in class, general rehearsals in the hall, stage setup and technical preparation, performance for families, and friendship drink after the show.
articles.author: Organizing Committee
articles.schedule: Preparation: Rehearsals • Technical: Stage setup • Evening: Performance and celebration

articles.title: Olympic Day
articles.excerpt: Multi-sport competition following the Olympic Games model
articles.content:
Event Presentation:
Inspired by the Olympic Games, this day offers varied events where each child can shine according to their sports talents.

Educational Objectives:

• Discover different sports disciplines
• Value effort and perseverance
• Learn to win and lose with elegance
• Develop team spirit

Planned Schedule:

Opening ceremony and athletes' oath, rotation through sports workshops, lunch break and rest, final events by category, medal ceremony, and return to school with debriefing.
articles.author: Prof. Sport
articles.schedule: Morning: Opening and workshops • Mid-day: Lunch break • Afternoon: Finals and ceremony • Return: Debriefing
